line: Shiva sits inside the silence you have been running from for years.
visual: Shiva seated absolutely still at the centre of a vast, lightless cave, a single shaft of deep indigo bioluminescence falling on his closed eyes while the lower third dissolves into black stone floor and pooling shadow, the silence made visible by ash drifting upward in slow spirals around him.

line: Kali does not flinch at the version of you that you have never shown anyone.
visual: Kali in direct eye contact with the viewer, blood-red and violet firelight carving her face from total darkness, the lower third sinking into black smoke

line: Saraswati knows what you abandoned because someone told you it was not practical.
visual: Saraswati reaching one hand toward a half-finished canvas or instrument lying face-down on a dark floor, deep teal and gold light pooling only on her hand and the abandoned object, the lower third lost in layered shadow, dust motes hanging in the beam like time that has stopped.

line: Vishnu sustains the life you have decided is not worth sustaining.
visual: Vishnu reclining on the cosmic ocean, one arm extended beneath the surface of dark indigo water as if holding something submerged and precious, the lower third entirely underwater and black, faint gold light radiating from his palm upward through the dark water, the surface barely visible above.

line: Durga holds the boundary you collapsed because you feared being called difficult.
visual: Durga braced at a threshold, her body filling a narrow doorway of ember-orange and blood-red light, the space behind her deep violet and protected, the lower third a dark stone floor cracked under the pressure of what she is holding back, her arms extended wide against the frame's edges.

line: Yama records every choice you made out of fear and calls none of them shameful.
visual: Yama bent over an enormous open ledger that glows deep gold from within, the recorded lines of text visible as light, the lower third consumed by black smoke and the suggestion of an abyss beneath the writing desk, his expression absorbed and without judgment as the pages fill themselves.

line: Hanuman carries the weight you insist only you were strong enough to have survived.
visual: Hanuman mid-stride through a dark landscape carrying an enormous boulder of compressed darkness on his shoulders, deep teal sky above and the lower third black earth under his feet, the boulder itself radiating a faint blood-red light as if something alive is sealed inside it.

line: Krishna watched you choose suffering over uncertainty and did not look away.
visual: Krishna standing at a distance in deep indigo dusk, face turned toward the viewer across an empty field, the lower third lost in dark unlit grass and shadow, a single ember-gold flame from his flute illuminating only his watching eyes, the rest of the frame held in saturated violet twilight.

line: Lakshmi does not arrive where you have taught yourself you are undeserving.
visual: Lakshmi paused at the edge of a doorway, gold and lotus-pink light blazing behind her, her foot lifted but not crossing the threshold, the interior she faces plunged in deep shadow and black, the lower third a dark floor with no offering, the contrast between her radiance and the unlit room absolute.
